title: Perception Test: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Video Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating multiple variations of video scripts with the exact same questions and options to test whether models rely on linguistic priors (textual cues that give away the answer) instead of grounding their answers in the actual visual content.

Comparing model performance against a dummy frequency-based baseline to evaluate if models are artificially inflating their accuracy by exploiting statistical imbalances in the dataset's answer distributions rather than performing true multimodal reasoning.
